title: ExtendedAE issue #689: ME Void Cell: replace 'getAmountPerUnit()' with 'getAmountPerOperation()' for void energy accumulation

text:
[issue by Misaka2592]
## Related: #677 

## Summary

The Void Cell and AE2's Matter Condenser both manufacture singularities, but they differ in calculating the accumulation: Void Cell divides by `getAmountPerUnit()` while the condenser divides by `getAmountPerOperation()` ([CondenserMEStorage#L44](https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/1.21.1/src/main/java/appeng/blockentity/misc/CondenserMEStorage.java#L44), [CondenserBlockEntity#L270](https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/1.21.1/src/main/java/appeng/blockentity/misc/CondenserBlockEntity.java#L270)).

Here's a table for items, fluids and AppFlux's FE:

| Key | Condenser (`storedPower`) | Void Cell (`voidEnergy`) |
|---|---|---|
| Items | 1 item | 1 item |
| Fluids | 125 mB | 1,000 mB |
| FE | 16,384 FE | 1 FE |

Per singularity needs 256,000 points (default `condenser.singularity`); matter balls scale the same way.

AppFlux only overrides `getAmountPerByte()` and `getAmountPerOperation()`, leaving `perUnit` at 1 ([FluxKeyType](https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE/blob/appflux/1.21.1-neoforge/src/main/java/com/glodblock/github/appflux/common/me/key/type/FluxKeyType.java)). So in the long term this will not be AppFlux-specific — any AEKey without perUnit overridden gets a 1:1 ratio. Besides, the condenser already weights FE with 'perOperation' and the Void Cell could make it the same way.

## Proposal

```diff
- this.voidEnergy += (double) amount / what.getAmountPerUnit();
+ this.voidEnergy += (double) amount / what.getAmountPerOperation();
```

Results: items unchanged; fluids 8× cheaper; FE 16,384× more expensive, which is 4,194,304,000 FE vs. 256,000 FE per singularity. Other AEKey types will use their own `getAmountPerOperation()` value, so their rates change accordingly.

Btw, I wonder if the 1:1 FE-voidEnergy conversion is working as intended or just a stopgap for the future weighted matter system? If not, would you accept the one-line change above?
Thanks for reading!
 
Versions: ExtendedAE 1.21-2.2.42-neoforge, AppFlux 1.21-2.1.7-neoforge, AE2 19.2.18, MC 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.194

[comment by GlodBlock (owner)]
Yeah I mistake these two method, now it's fixed
